newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong revises up 1996 sales forecast.
newsitem.headline: Yukong revises up 1996 sales forecast.

text.p: Yukong Ltd, South Korea's largest oil refiner, said on Wednesday it had revised its 1996 sales forecast to 8.2 trillion won, up 14 percent from the previous estimate of 7.2 trillion.

"Successful commercialisation of its new crude distillation unit (CDU), residue fluid catalytic cracker (RFCC) and residue desulphuriser in the second half of this year is expected to boost sales," a Yukong spokesman said.
The new 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) CDU started commercial operations over the weekend, and the 50,000 bpd RFCC and the 60,000 bpd residue desulphuriser in August.
"The company will also attempt to raise sales by strengthening our marketing competitiveness," he said.
The refiner, which has a total crude processing capacity of 810,000 bpd, posted turnover of 6.6 trillion won in 1995.
